system.description:
Hachiman's Brutality – Hobbled.

The inflicting strike disabled your defense and agility making you a sitting duck. Hobbled is treated as a Physical condition.

A Hobbled creature cannot move further than 5 feet on their turn.

A Hobbled creature makes saving throws to resist being moved at disadvantage.

A Hobbled creature makes melee weapon and Taijutsu attacks at disadvantage.

This condition ends at the end of an affected creatures turn.
system.summary: Moves at most 5 ft on its turn; disadvantage on saves against forced movement and on melee weapon and Taijutsu attacks; ends at the end of its turn.

rules.text: At most 5 ft of movement on its turn; disadvantage on saves against being moved and on melee weapon and Taijutsu attacks (at the table).
